scope: Bounded exact operator counterexample and limits of the already completed response calibration; no new N36 query, H action, sampling, training, or state optimization.

same_two_site_RDM_counterexample.state_definition: psi_plus/minus=(tensor_i v_i_plus +/- tensor_i v_i_minus)/sqrt(2), where v_i_plus=(cos(theta_i/2),sin(theta_i/2)), v_i_minus=(-sin(theta_i/2),cos(theta_i/2)) in down/up order
same_two_site_RDM_counterexample.interpretation: General operator counterexample: identical complete two-site RDMs, parent energy, source norm and static oscillator ratio do not fix the actual response first moment. These parents are deliberately not singlets or ground states, so this is not a triangular QSL classifier or a fixed-Sz phase comparison. Negative relative centroids are allowed for such parents.

approximate_parent_identity.definition: For O(k)=sum_i exp(ik.r_i) Sz_i/sqrt(N), A=O^dagger O, g=<A>, r=(H-Epsi)psi; the +/-k symmetrized first response centroid relative to Epsi is [f_z(k)+Re<A r>]/g. Physical inversion of the exact full-A1 parent makes +/-k branches equal.
approximate_parent_identity.exact_Cauchy_Schwarz_bound: |<A r>|/g <= sqrt(Var_psi(A))*||r||/g, conditional on the TRUE parent residual norm. A sampled non-certified variance is not an interval bound.
approximate_parent_identity.statistical_propagation: The six-point sidecar recomputes Epsi, g, f, Cov and both ratios within the same leave-one-whole-chain-out rows, including the shared conditional-RDM four snapshots. This preserves observed inter-estimator covariance, but does not remove nonlinear ratio plug-in bias or certify equilibrium/unseen tails.
approximate_parent_identity.energy_reference: mu=E_phi-Epsi is not a ground-state excitation gap or its upper bound when Epsi-E0 is unknown. Exact source momentum can hold while the total-spin q2 label fails for an ordinary fixed-Sz parent.
approximate_parent_identity.spin_leakage: For true normalized parent leakage eta outside S=0 and a vector source O, the response component not inherited from the singlet is bounded by ||O||^2 eta/g. A small uncertified sampled S_tot^2 estimate is not exact SU2 and can be amplified by small g.

N36_dimer_query_cost_correction.support_warning: The 15139-mask envelope is ONLY the action H D psi at a queried computational configuration. It is not an unconditional Born-parent Monte Carlo cost for response Gram or energy matrices. Coherent A1 psi can have exact nodes while D psi is nonzero there; weighting parent samples by |Dpsi/psi|^2 then misses response support. Without support proof use direct faithful Ddagger D / Ddagger H D operator expansion, or separately authorized response/mixture sampling. The current saved nine-bond symmetrized DMRG connected matrix is also not the complete ordered complex 108-bond orientation Gram.
N36_dimer_query_cost_correction.diagonal_spin_advantage_and_limit: O_z psi vanishes at every parent node, making its norm and the present first-moment covariance legal from parent Born records. However H O_z psi may populate those nodes. A future response variance/residual cannot be inferred from full E_loc alone or blindly from parent-weighted |H O_z psi/psi|^2 without faithful-support treatment.

next_minimal_physical_question: At a fixed geometry and quality-controlled parent, does the actual scalar dimer q0 response at X and vector spin q2 response at K/M develop a jointly controlled low-energy manifold, with momentum/spin labels, source norm, energy reference and response residual validated? The current six-point longitudinal first moments only establish source-dependent spectral-weight redistribution, not this low-energy statement.
not_worth_doing_now: More local scalar/Holevo classifiers after strict-singlet magnetic-cat counterexamples.
Fitting finite-strip partial-rotation zeros or charged-Renyi curves to a thermodynamic cusp, log(2), or emergent gauge label.
Calling static F/S or the corrected first moment a gap, choosing the smallest noisy M, or labeling ordinary-ViT responses strict triplets.
Launching a twist grid on one even-width 6x6 torus before independent low-energy branches and quality control exist.
Assuming 4x4 saved N16 calibration contains physical K or X momenta; it only calibrates M-source algebra.
